title: 卖两成股份：投票权一点没少，扎克伯格怎么做到的
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: Mark Zuckerberg was considering leaving California because of a repose wealth tax.
segments.zh: 马克·扎克伯格曾考虑离开加州，因为一项财富税提议。

segments.en: Proposition 40 would impose a one-time 5% tax on billionaires.
segments.zh: 第40号提案将对亿万富翁征收一次性5%的税。

segments.en: For Zuckerberg, meta says that would have been a multi-billion dollar tax bill that would require him to sell the shares that give him voting power
segments.zh: Meta表示，对扎克伯格来说，这将是数十亿美元的税单，需要他出售赋予投票权的股份，

segments.en: in order to get liquidity to cover that tax bill.
segments.zh: 以获得流动性来支付该税单。

segments.en: So meta came up with another solution. They're going to issue class C shares.
segments.zh: 因此Meta提出了另一个解决方案：发行C类股。

segments.en: The shares have economic value but they don't have any voting rights.
segments.zh: 这些股份具有经济价值，但不具备投票权。

segments.en: Every shareholder is going to get them including Zuckerberg, but he can immediately sell 20% of the class C shares without reducing his voting power.
segments.zh: 每位股东都将获得这些股份，包括扎克伯格，但他可以立即出售20%的C类股而不减少投票权。

segments.en: And meta says explicitly he can use that money to cover a potential wealth tax.
segments.zh: Meta明确表示，他可以用这笔钱来支付潜在的财富税。

segments.en: More of his class C shares than become fully sellable over an eight-year period if he continues to leave meta.
segments.zh: 如果他继续留在Meta，更多C类股将在八年内逐步可出售。

segments.en: And what Mark Zuckerberg has agreed according to the filing is to remain in California or wherever meta chooses to be headquartered over that eight-year period
segments.zh: 根据文件，马克·扎克伯格同意在这八年期间留在加州或Meta选择的总部所在地。

segments.en: leading the projects that are most important largely AI. The thing is on the company's quality earnings call, the rationale for the class C shares being issued was presented slightly differently
segments.zh: 主导最重要的项目，主要是AI。问题在于，在公司高质量财报电话会上，发行C类股的理由陈述略有不同

segments.en: as a mechanism to finance or fund some of the AI spending that the company is committed to.
segments.zh: 作为一种机制，为公司承诺的部分AI支出提供资金。

segments.en: And the backdrop is a really strong quarter like meta B expectations against clarity on its spending is said things are looking good going into next year and try to give as many examples as possible of all of the investment it's made into AI
segments.zh: 背景是季度表现非常强劲，Meta超出预期，支出清晰，称明年形势良好，并尽量举例说明所有AI投入

segments.en: sort of bolstering its core advertising business which continues to outperform.
segments.zh: 这在一定程度上支撑了其核心广告业务，该业务持续表现优异。
